content: Name Spi_ Async Mode Type Kind Enumeration Range SPI_ POLLING_ MODE 0x00 The asynchronous mechanism is ensured by polling, so interrupts related to SPI busses handled asynchronously are disabled. SPI_ INTERRUPT_ MODE 0x01 The asynchronous mechanism is ensured by interrupt, so interrupts related to SPI busses handled asynchron ously are enabled. Description Specifies the asynchronous mechanism mode for SPI busses handled asynchronously in LEVEL 2. Available via Spi.h
